ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: `setToken` and `clearToken` are referenced but NOT imported from ../lib/api. login() silently throws ReferenceError on setToken(data.access_token) after the await — so `hivf_token` is NEVER written to localStorage. Logout throws 'ReferenceError: clearToken is not defined' (visible as a runtime-error overlay in the browser). This DEFEATS the entire purpose of Case 6's Bearer-token fallback: if a browser blocks cross-site cookies (Safari ITP, strict 3p-cookie mode), login appears to succeed but no token is stored → next request fails. Today it 'works' only because the httpOnly cookie path still authenticates.

Sidebar nav is missing a Marketing entry. /marketing route + page exist in App.js, but there is no nav-marketing link (only Dashboard, Leads, Follow-ups, Call Center, WhatsApp, Reports, Templates, Admin). End users have no UI path to reach Marketing. Review-request explicitly calls for `nav-marketing` testid.

action_items: 1) In /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx change `import { API } from '../lib/api'` → `import { API, setToken, clearToken } from '../lib/api'`. Verify after fix: after admin login, `localStorage.getItem('hivf_token')` should be a non-empty JWT; logout should clear it without an overlay error.

rca of the issue: AuthContext.jsx line 1 only imports { API } from '../lib/api' but lines 32 and 41 call setToken() and clearToken() respectively. Those are exported from lib/api.js but never imported into AuthContext.jsx, so at runtime they resolve to undefined globals → ReferenceError. The login error is swallowed because it occurs after `await API.post(...)` resolves and the surrounding component .then chain ignores it; subsequent navigations succeed only because the server's httpOnly cookie was set in the same response. Logout throws synchronously inside the .finally block which surfaces React's error overlay. Fix: change the import to `import { API, setToken, clearToken } from '../lib/api';`.
